=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py:195-198 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The marker loop in `test_registry_entries_are_well_formed` reads `marker["name"]` and looks it up in the `discovered` set with no type check first. A marker with no name raises KeyError, and a list or dict name raises `TypeError: unhashable type`, before the assertion message (`marker`) is built.
  WHY: The last run added this type check to `_undiscovered_without_pending` (lines 110-117) but not to the same lookup here. A malformed marker such as `{"name": ["X"], "pending": true, ...}` passes `load_registry` and then crashes the test instead of naming the bad marker. Both reviewers rated this NIT, and the suggested fix is about 2 lines that copy the helper's `isinstance(name, str)` check.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Issue #10127 G4: "entries registered ahead of a merge by the interim pull request are accepted (G3 `pending`) and can be removed once their pull request merges or closes"; G3: "every JSON entry and every `off_on_purpose` marker names a discovered switch or carries an explicit `pending: true` field"
  expected_change_site: `scripts/stage_switches.json` on the merged tree (`refs/pull/<n>/merge`, after the branch is updated from main). Every interim-registered `_ENABLED` entry or marker that discovery does not find needs `"pending": true`, or must be removed once its PR closes. The alternative is for `test_registry_entries_name_discovered_or_pending` (tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py line 121) and the marker assertion at line 196 to accept those entries.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR adds the `pending` logic to `scripts/stage_switch_watch.py` and `tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py` but has no hunk that updates `scripts/stage_switches.json`, and the file is not in the plan grant's `files_touched`. On head eeda4298, `scripts/stage_switches.json` has no `pending` field, and grep finds no `STABLE_ROLLBACK_ENABLED` or `GH_CALL_COUNTER_ENABLED`; the only match is unrelated prose at line 246. Final CI already failed on the merged tree for head 3110bc55 (`ai:final-ci-failed:v1 pr=10130 head=3110bc55`). Final CI runs against `refs/pull/<n>/merge` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` lines 4446-4448), which carries main's interim-only entries. The judge's helper run on the head returned `([], [])` because main's strays are not present there. The last run's diff only changes how non-string marker names are reported in `_undiscovered_without_pending` (lines 110-117). It does not bring in main, mark any entry `pending`, or relax the stray check, so head eeda4298 will fail final CI the same way. Two judge rounds asked for main to be merged in and the strays marked `pending`; that has not happened, and `origin/main` cannot be reached from the sandbox. Reviewers rated this MAJOR (sonnet, gemini, luna) or BLOCKER (minimax, glm).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py:195-198 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: In `test_registry_entries_are_well_formed`, the check `assert marker["name"] in discovered or (marker.get("pending") is True and str(marker["name"]).endswith("_ENABLED")), marker` reads `marker["name"]` with no type check. A missing name raises KeyError and a list or dict name raises `TypeError: unhashable type`, before the assertion message is built.
  WHY: This only affects a malformed registry, which CI still rejects, but the failure shows up as an exception rather than an assertion that names the bad marker. Suggested fix (about 2 lines): `name = marker.get("name")` and `assert (isinstance(name, str) and name in discovered) or (marker.get("pending") is True and str(name).endswith("_ENABLED")), marker`. The same item is repeated under HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1. (2 related items)
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Issue #10127 G4 "entries registered ahead of a merge by the interim pull request are accepted (G3 `pending`) and can be removed once their pull request merges or closes"; G3 "every JSON entry and every `off_on_purpose` marker names a discovered switch or carries an explicit `pending: true` field". The interim PR was written before the `pending` field existed.
  Expected change site: `scripts/stage_switches.json` on the PR merged into main (`refs/pull/<n>/merge`), with `"pending": true` added to undiscovered interim `_ENABLED` entries or markers. The alternative is for `test_registry_entries_name_discovered_or_pending` (`tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py` line 121) and the marker assertion at line 196 to accept them.
  Evidence of absence: `scripts/stage_switches.json` has no `pending` field, and a search for `pending`, `STABLE_ROLLBACK_ENABLED` and `GH_CALL_COUNTER_ENABLED` finds only unrelated prose at line 246. Final CI already failed for head 3110bc55 (`ai:final-ci-failed:v1 pr=10130 head=3110bc55`). The last run's diff does not bring in main or mark any entry `pending`, so head eeda4298 will meet the same condition. No CI log was available, so the cause is not confirmed.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
